summary: The PM-KISAN scheme provides farmers with a total of ₹6,000 every year, which is paid in three equal parts. This benefit is available to landowners who possess up to two hectares of agricultural land, while those who rent their land are not eligible. To receive this money, you need to have your Aadhaar card, land records, and bank passbook ready. You can apply for this support at any time throughout the year.
